question: Who became the Chief Election Commissioner of India in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanesh Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gyanesh Kumar** was appointed as the **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) of India** in **February 2025**, succeeding the outgoing Chief Election Commissioner.
 
• The **Chief Election Commissioner** is the head of the **Election Commission of India**, responsible for overseeing free and fair elections in the country.
 
• The appointment of the Chief Election Commissioner is made by the **President of India**, as per **Article 324** of the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• Gyanesh Kumar has a distinguished record in public service and administration, having held several key positions in the Indian government prior to his appointment as CEC.
